steps.expected: Command fails closed with malformed-contract guidance and plaintext secret stays out of .hack/.env
steps.observed: exit 1; hack.env.json=True; fix/remove=True; malformed=True; .env contains secret=False

evidence.consoleErrors: not applicable (CLI and local HTTP validation)
evidence.network: POST /v1/env/set over isolated unix socket returned 409 for both malformed classes

frictions.description: The previously built <repo>/dist/hack binary was stale and initially allowed plaintext writes for both malformed-contract CLI probes until the repo-local build was refreshed.
frictions.resolution: Ran bun run build to regenerate <repo>/dist/hack from the current branch, then reran the CLI smoke against the rebuilt binary.

summary: Non-contract smoke passed: rebuilt <repo>/dist/hack and the isolated current-branch daemon both failed closed for broken JSON and semantically invalid JSON-valid contracts, returned malformed-contract guidance mentioning hack.env.json plus “Fix or remove the contract file”, kept the attempted plaintext secrets out of .hack/.env, and the targeted bun tests exited 0.
